mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_evaluation_report (teacher_id, course_id, course_name, teacher_name, avg_satisfaction, response_count, llm_analysis_report) VALUES (#{teacherId}, #{courseId}, #{courseName}, #{teacherName}, #{avgSatisfaction}, #{responseCount}, #{llmAnalysisReport})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_evaluation_report SET course_name = #{courseName}, teacher_name = #{teacherName}, avg_satisfaction = #{avgSatisfaction}, response_count = #{responseCount}, llm_analysis_report = #{llmAnalysisReport} WHERE id = #{id}
